It has a sweet fragrance.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Fairy Tonics by using at least one [[Fairy]] on a [[Cooking Pot]]. These elixirs harness the power of Fairies, making them able to heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Therefore, the more Fairies used, the stronger their effects will be. Their fragrance is known to be sweet. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Fairy Tonics are [[Food]]s that can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] with [[Fairy|Fairies]] at a [[Cooking Pot]] or [[Portable Pot]]. They harness the healing power of the Fairies used in their recipe to restore [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. They are known to have a sweet fragrance. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Fairy Tonic is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Unexpected Discovery]]". It is made using one [[Fairy]]. When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]] will be automatically revived once after being KO'd. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Fairy Tonic Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Fairy Tonic icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
